name: Telegram Bot Redirector
description: A web app to dynamically redirect users to multiple Telegram bots.

DB_NAME.description: Name of the database to use for storing bot data (default: telegram_redirector)

CUSTOM_DOMAIN.description: Your custom domain (e.g., https://www.yourcustomdomain.com). Leave empty to use the default platform domain.

PORT.description: The port the application should listen on (default is 5000)
